niche: deciding how many sub-scale scores a grocery chain's employee engagement dashboard reports, from the dimensionality of its 30 survey items (14 five-point statements and 16 yes or no experience questions)
answer: Report three sub-scales on the 2027 engagement dashboard: Resources (11 items: the workload statements and the tools questions), Manager and growth (11 items: the manager statements and the growth questions) and Connection (8 items: the belonging and recognition items)
answer_source: submission.md block 1; golden engagement_subscales_2027.xlsx (Items sheet) and engagement_subscales_2027.md

spine.entity: one respondent's answer to one survey question

world.geography: Canada (Ontario, Quebec and New Brunswick; a fictional grocery chain, its survey vendor and its people)

driver: The decisive quantity is how many distinct latent dimensions a set of categorical responses carries when some items are answered one way by nearly everyone and others the opposite way by nearly everyone; correlating the category codes as if they were measurements caps each pair's correlation by how far apart their splits sit, so items sharing a lopsided split correlate with each other beyond what their content shares, a rule that keeps the dimensions standing above random data keeps artificial ones, and only correlating the responses as cuts through underlying continuous views shows the true number.
driver_concrete: Thirty engagement items from 13,717 Brackenmere respondents: the six tools questions are answered yes by 93.7 to 95.0 per cent and the six growth questions by 4.5 to 6.7 per cent; Pearson (phi) correlations give fourth and fifth eigenvalues of 1.49 and 1.34 against random data's 1.07 and 1.06, so parallel analysis, Kaiser's rule and MAP keep five sub-scales with tools and growth split from the workload and manager statements, while tetrachoric and polychoric correlations (eigenvalues 9.75, 6.01, 2.21, then 0.78) keep three (resources, manager and growth, connection) under every retention test, extraction and rotation.
stump: A competent solver reverse-scores the negative statements, codes yes and no, drops the does-not-apply codes, correlates the 30 answers, keeps the dimensions above random data and reports five sub-scales (workload, tools, manager, growth, and belonging with recognition); the step that lands it there is correlating lopsided yes or no answers as scores, whose correlations are capped by their splits and manufacture two dimensions out of the splits, so only latent (tetrachoric and polychoric) correlations give the three the items measure.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the export and reads every item and rule correctly correlates the answers (Pearson), keeps the dimensions that beat random data, and reports five sub-scales with tools and growth split off as their own; correlating the answers as cuts through underlying views (tetrachoric and polychoric) gives three.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the number of latent dimensions a psychological scale measures, read from the items' ordinal correlation structure with the field's retention test; swapped into a field with no latent construct measured by rating items (stock lines, hospital wards), there is no item, no category threshold and no dimensionality to test, so the task no longer reads the same.
